✅ **Fixed!** All tests are now passing (5/5).

**The bug:** The `isExpired` function was using `<` (less than) instead of `<=` (less than or equal), which allowed tokens to slip through at the exact moment of expiration. According to the spec ("A token is considered expired the moment `exp` is reached"), tokens should be rejected when `exp === nowSeconds`.

**The fix:** Changed line 7 from `return token.exp < nowSeconds;` to `return token.exp <= nowSeconds;`

This ensures expired tokens are properly caught at the boundary condition, preventing them from being accepted after their expiration time.
